title: Engram control card says 'Original failure details unavailable' while its causal details are only pending a durable save
outcome: Engram control card says 'Original failure details unavailable' while its causal details are only pending a durable save
acceptance: While a cause is publication-pending, or after its acknowledgement failed, the wire carries a value-free 'details pending durable save' marker and the card renders neutral wording for it; 'Original failure details unavailable' is kept for legacy cards that truly have no cause; covered by a UI test and a wire test.
